name: base64enc
resume: Checked base64encode, base64decode, dataURI, and checkUTF8. The other exports are listed and not translated.

functions.name: base64encode
functions.done: Encodes a raw vector or a file as base64, and splits or joins the lines from linewidth and newline.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(base64enc))
x <- 1:100
invisible(base64encode(x, 70))
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- base64encode(x, 70)
  elapsed[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
}
med <- median(elapsed)
cat(sprintf("r_ms %.17g\n", med * 1000))
cat(result, sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from base64enc.base64encode import base64encode

x = list(range(1, 101))
base64encode(x, 70)
elapsed = []
result = None
for _ in range(20):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = base64encode(x, 70)
    elapsed.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
med = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(f"py_ms {med * 1000:.17g}")
print("\n".join(result))

functions.name: base64decode
functions.done: Decodes base64 text from strings, bytes, or connections into bytes, or writes them to a file or binary connection.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(base64enc))
enc <- base64encode(1:100, 70)
invisible(base64decode(enc))
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- base64decode(enc)
  elapsed[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
}
med <- median(elapsed)
cat(sprintf("r_ms %.17g\n", med * 1000))
cat(paste(as.integer(result), collapse = " "), "\n")
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from base64enc.base64decode import base64decode
from base64enc.base64encode import base64encode

enc = base64encode(list(range(1, 101)), 70)
base64decode(enc)
elapsed = []
result = None
for _ in range(20):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = base64decode(enc)
    elapsed.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
med = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(f"py_ms {med * 1000:.17g}")
print(" ".join(str(b) for b in result))

functions.name: checkUTF8
functions.done: Validates UTF-8 bytes with the same error text, quiet mode, and charlen mode as base64enc 0.1-6.

check.case: checkUTF8 of the raw bytes of Hello, world repeated 10000 times

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(base64enc))
x <- charToRaw(paste(rep("Hello, 世界\n", 10000), collapse = ""))
invisible(checkUTF8(x))
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- checkUTF8(x)
  elapsed[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
}
med <- median(elapsed)
cat(sprintf("r_ms %.17g\n", med * 1000))
cat(result, "\n")
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from base64enc.checkUTF8 import checkUTF8

x = ("Hello, 世界\n" * 10000).encode("utf-8")
checkUTF8(x)
elapsed = []
result = None
for _ in range(20):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = checkUTF8(x)
    elapsed.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
med = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(f"py_ms {med * 1000:.17g}")
print(result)
